# Titles, the bell, the directory, shell marks, the clipboard, hyperlinks
# and notifications. Each one is an event; links are also per-row spans.
# Columns in a link line are 0-based and half-open. A notification shows
# as `notify title|body`.

=== OSC 0 names the icon and the window
source: xterm ctlseqs OSC Ps = 0
input: \e]0;hello\x07
events:
|title 0 hello|

=== OSC 1 and OSC 2 name one of them each
source: xterm ctlseqs OSC Ps = 1, Ps = 2
input: \e]1;icon\x07\e]2;window\x07
events:
|title 1 icon|
|title 2 window|

=== Several BELs are one bell
source: xterm ctlseqs BEL
input: \x07\x07a\x07
events:
|bell|

=== A BEL that ends an OSC is not a bell
source: xterm ctlseqs OSC (BEL terminator)
input: \e]2;t\x07
events:
|title 2 t|

=== OSC 7 reports the working directory
source: iTerm2 Proprietary Escape Codes OSC 7
input: \e]7;file://host/tmp\x07
events:
|cwd file://host/tmp|

=== OSC 133 marks the prompt and the command's exit
source: VS Code shell integration (OSC 133 A and D)
input: \e]133;A\x07\e]133;D;0\x07
events:
|shell A|
|shell D 0|

=== OSC 52 write is a clipboard event
source: xterm ctlseqs OSC 52 (base64 Pd)
input: \e]52;c;aGk=\x07
events:
|clip write c hi|

=== OSC 52 query is a read the host may deny
source: xterm ctlseqs OSC 52 (Pd = ?)
input: \e]52;p;?\x1b\\
events:
|clip read p|

=== Broken OSC 52 base64 is dropped whole
source: xterm ctlseqs OSC 52
input: \e]52;c;!!!!\x07
events:

=== OSC 8 paints a per-row span and then stops
source: OSC 8 hyperlinks (egmontkob gist)
size: 6x1
input: \e]8;id=a;https://example.com\e\\ab\e]8;;\e\\c
events:
|link 1 https://example.com|
links:
|1 0..2=1|
screen:
|abc...|

=== A link follows a wrap onto the next row
source: OSC 8 hyperlinks (egmontkob gist)
size: 4x2
input: \e]8;;http://x\e\\abcdef\e]8;;\e\\
events:
|link 1 http://x|
links:
|1 0..4=1|
|2 0..2=1|
screen:
|abcd|
|ef..|

=== A wide character's link covers both cells
source: OSC 8 hyperlinks (egmontkob gist); Unicode UAX #11
size: 4x1
input: \e]8;;http://x\e\\\xe3\x81\x82\e]8;;\e\\
events:
|link 1 http://x|
links:
|1 0..2=1|
screen:
|あ..|

=== OSC 9 is a notification with no title
source: iTerm2 Proprietary Escape Codes OSC 9 (Post a Notification)
input: \e]9;build done\x07
events:
|notify |build done|

=== ConEmu's OSC 9 subcommands are not notifications
source: ConEmu ANSI escape codes OSC 9;4 (progress) and OSC 9;9 (directory)
input: \e]9;4;1;50\x07\e]9;9;/tmp\x07
events:

=== OSC 777 notify carries a title and a body
source: rxvt-unicode notify extension (OSC 777;notify;title;body)
input: \e]777;notify;make;all; done\e\\
events:
|notify make|all; done|

=== Other OSC 777 commands are ignored
source: rxvt-unicode perl extensions (OSC 777)
input: \e]777;precmd\x07
events:
